85:10.text: Steadfast love and faithfulness will meet; righteousness and peace will kiss each other.

19:1.text: The heavens are telling the glory of God; and the firmament proclaims his handiwork.
19:1.notes: Superscription 'To the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.' is printed before v. 1 (biblestudytools shows it inside v. 1); not part of the verse text. Ch. 12 Further Study.
